# Webpushr

Webpushr enables websites to send push notification campaigns to all subscribers, segments, custom audiences, or individual subscribers and monitor campaign delivery.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/webpushr/.

## Actions

- **Get Notification Status** (read-only): Get delivery and engagement counts for a Webpushr notification campaign using its campaign ID.
- **Get Subscriber Count** (read-only): Return lifetime and currently active subscriber counts for the connected Webpushr site.
- **Send Notification by Attributes**: Create or schedule a push notification campaign for subscribers matching any supplied custom attribute key/value pair.
- **Send Notification to All Subscribers**: Create or schedule a push notification campaign for every subscriber of the connected Webpushr site.
- **Send Notification to Segments**: Create or schedule a push notification campaign for subscribers in one or more Webpushr segments.
- **Send Notification to Subscriber**: Send or schedule a push notification to one Webpushr subscriber ID.
